subject: Logic
title: The Base Rate Trap
description: One-minute skill: The Base Rate Trap.

hook.text: A test is 99% accurate. You test positive. The disease affects 1 in 10,000. What are your real odds?

buildup.text: Most people say 99%. The actual chance you have the disease? About 1%. The base rate changes everything.

discovery.text: In 10,000 people: 1 truly positive, 100 false positives (1% error on 9,999 healthy). You're likely a false positive.

twist.text: Ignoring base rates—base rate neglect—leads to panic, wrongful convictions, and wasted resources.

climax.text: Always combine test accuracy with how common the condition is. One without the other misleads.

punchline.text: Rare events stay rare, even with good tests.

quiz.question: What does base rate neglect ignore?
options: How common the condition is in the population
